test_drop_collection: test the MigrationDropCollection class to drop a MongoDB collection and verify it raises IrreversibleMigrationError on rollback
create_MigrationDropCollection: create a MigrationDropCollection migration instance with version, description, collection_name, and alias parameters
run_migration_up: run the MigrationDropCollection.up() method to drop a specified MongoDB collection from a database alias
run_migration_down: run the MigrationDropCollection.down() method which raises IrreversibleMigrationError since rollback is not supported
run_migration_validate: run the MigrationDropCollection.validate() method to check that the target collection no longer exists in the database
